title: Timelost Camp
description: An explorer's camp sits frozen between heartbeats of time, a half-eaten meal still steaming on a plate that hasn't aged in decades. Supplies and equipment hang suspended in perfect preservation, untouched by rust or rot, waiting for a moment that will never come.

choices.label: Take the preserved supplies
choices.description: The food, coin purses, and trade goods are all in pristine condition.

outcomes.text: The coins are from an era long past, but gold is gold. You pocket a tidy sum from the frozen purses.
Along with the coins, you find preserved rations and a crystal fruit that somehow still glows with vitality.
As you grab the supplies, the time bubble collapses. Decades of entropy hit everything at once — including you. A wave of temporal shock surges through your body.

choices.label: Gather the temporal residue
choices.description: The edges of the time bubble shed flakes of solidified temporal energy.

outcomes.text: You carefully peel temporal residue from the shimmering boundary. It crumbles like frozen light between your fingers.
The residue is rich here — whole sheets of crystallized time peel away from the bubble's edge.
A shard of solidified time cuts your hand as you collect it. The wound ages and heals in rapid succession, leaving you dizzy.

choices.label: Leave the camp untouched
choices.description: Disturbing a time-frozen site feels like tampering with something best left alone.

outcomes.text: You step back from the shimmering boundary. The frozen explorer stares forever at a meal they will never finish.
